name: Potion Dealer
summary:
Iva, found as an infant in a river and adopted by a court noblewoman, spent her youth within the royal castle. At sixteen, she learns she is the daughter of a witch. Believing her future is limitless, she slips a love potion to the royal heir.

Two years later, the wedding ritual unravels—and her deception is exposed.

She barely escapes. Now hunted, Iva hides in a remote mountain hut, gathering herbs and brewing forbidden potions to sell—just to survive and pay for her safety.

But survival is not enough.

To break free from this trap, she must uncover the truth and take revenge on those who exploited her inexperience and set her up. It won’t be easy: her downfall is only a small piece of a much larger conspiracy.
